about_the_game:
Artificial Player

Artificial Player is an advanced tool that lets you create and run artificial intelligence agents that control games like a human would — using the mouse and keyboard.
You don’t need any game engine integration or code access. All it needs is the screen.
The agent “sees” what you see and reacts: it moves, aims, presses buttons — autonomously, in real time.

What is Artificial Player, really?

It’s a platform for experimenting with intelligent input control in games and applications.
It works with any 3D environment that supports mouse and keyboard input — whether it’s a classic FPS,  a sandbox world, or your own educational project.

Thanks to advanced visual analysis and customizable behavior algorithms, you can create an AI player that:

  • navigates game maps,

  • recognizes enemies or objects,

  • reacts to the environment,

  • follows commands (like “find this” or “shoot that”).

And it does all this — without writing a single line of code.

Key Features:

AI-controlled player with real input

  • Artificial intelligence uses the mouse and keyboard like a human — no overlays, or game files integration.

Fully customizable behavior

  • Adjust movement logic, targeting priorities, reactions, sensitivity, delays, and more — all through a simple UI.

Works with any mouse + keyboard 3D game

  • Unity, Roblox, Minecraft, emulators, retro FPS games, and custom engines — just run it and let it play.

Test and QA modes

  • Run the agent in automated test loops, validate level flow, or repeat tasks without lifting a finger.

Accessibility support

  • Let AI assist users with reduced mobility — such as single-button setups.

Visual analysis and monitoring

  • Track decisions, movement heatmaps, aiming accuracy, and more — all visualized in real time.

Community & Prebuilt Models

Artificial Player is more than a tool — it’s a growing community platform.
The built-in Community Hub allows you to:

  • Browse, download, and run prebuilt AI models created by other users

  • Learn how to train your own agents

  • Share configurations and test scenarios

  • Get inspired and develop your own unique AI playstyle

⚠️ Usage Notice

Artificial Player is designed for offline, educational, and experimental use.

It is not intended for use in online multiplayer games with anti-cheat systems (e.g. Valorant, Apex Legends, Fortnite).

Using it in such games may result in account or hardware bans.

Users are solely responsible for how they use this application.

Who is Artificial Player for?

  • Game developers who want to test levels

  • QA testers automating gameplay

  • Educators teaching computer vision, reinforcement learning, or AI

  • AI enthusiasts and hobbyists

  • Creative players looking for new ways to interact with games

Artificial Player bridges gameplay and technology, creativity and control — connecting the human with the machine.

Are you ready to build your own player?
